name: StoryTeen
what_you_do: Teen internship in early literacy and early childhood education: training on child development and literacy, helping children's librarians with storytimes and events, and a creative project. About 100 hours total.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 10-12 at a NYC high school, with a parent's signed consent, available 3 to 5 hours a week outside school.
pay_detail: Stipend (amount not stated), plus volunteer service hours.
duration: Nov 2026 to May 2027, 3-5 hours a week, 100 hours total
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 were open through October 3, 2026. Expect the next call in fall 2027 (last-year pattern).
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Selected applicants are contacted for an interview. Questions: storyteen@bklynlibrary.org.
notes: Funded through the NYC Council's City's First Readers initiative. Whether a work permit is needed is not stated on the library pages; ask the program.
